attribution_limitations: Imaging response labels (PR/CR) are radiological (mRECIST-based). "Necrotic treated mass" is imaging language only; no biopsy, histology or explant is reported, and the final diagnosis rests on LI-RADS 5 imaging. No BCLC letter, TNM, Child-Pugh or ECOG is given beyond "early stage" and "preserved liver function".

The interval of the post-second-session CT is only stated in the figure caption (6 weeks), not in the narrative; 1-year and 6-year follow-up are anchored to the second session only by the figure captions, whereas the abstract says "approximately 1 year after DEB-TACE".

The coagulative-necrosis/dystrophic-calcification mechanism and calcification as a prognostic marker are explicit author hypotheses ("likely", "hypothesis-generating"); they are not established facts and are recorded review-only.

The personal/family history sentence ("Case 1 and Case 2 were unremarkable.") is shared between both patients and does not name specific habits or relatives; it must not be read as negating the documented cirrhosis and its etiology or inferring alcohol/tobacco/drug/exposure negatives.

Dox dose values are the amounts loaded onto the beads for each session; no systemic exposure, cumulative total or route beyond "transarterial" is stated. The 100-300 µm range is the bead size, not a tumor dimension. The cited prior case of dystrophic calcification after DEB-TACE is background literature and not this patient.
Case 2 response/AFP: AFP normalized after the second session but no numeric post-treatment value or reference range is given.
